limitations: The reproduction compares deterministic JSON behavior in fresh subprocesses; it does not establish a bit-identical whole-repository build across operating systems.
retrieval_method: Python 3 standard-library HTTPS GET with a descriptive research user agent; redirect target recorded.

source.admitted_claim: A build is reproducible when the same source, build environment, and instructions allow independent parties to recreate bit-for-bit identical artifacts.
